description: Apply standard React performance optimizations: add lazy loading to all images, wrap expensive components in React.memo to prevent unnecessary re-renders, add preconnect/dns-prefetch hints to index.html for Mapbox and Supabase domains, and wrap expensive computations in useMemo. These quick wins improve perceived performance and reduce CPU usage.
steps: 1. Add loading='lazy' attribute to tag in src/components/ui/ReportCard.jsx line 86 (report.photoPreview image), plus explicit width={44} height={44} attributes
2. Search for all other tags: grep -r '
3. Add loading='lazy' and explicit dimensions to all found images
4. Read .env to get VITE_SUPABASE_URL value for preconnect hints
5. Add preconnect and dns-prefetch links to index.html before existing stylesheet links: preconnect for https://api.mapbox.com, https://events.mapbox.com, and Supabase project URL from .env
6. Wrap ReportCard component export in React.memo: export default React.memo(ReportCard) in src/components/ui/ReportCard.jsx
7. Wrap PinMarker component in React.memo in src/components/map/MapPins.jsx: export const PinMarker = React.memo(function PinMarker({ color, icon }) { ... })

8. Break down ElNinoMonitoringDashboard.jsx into smaller memo'd components: extract AdvisoriesSection, HospitalSection, BFPSection, CDRRMOSection, AgricultureSection, InterruptionsSection as separate components wrapped in React.memo with props dependencies
9. Wrap expensive analytics calculations in OverviewTab (AdminDashboard.jsx) with useMemo, dependencies on data arrays
10. Test all changes with React DevTools Profiler to confirm memo'd components don't re-render when unrelated state changes
acceptance_criteria: All tags have loading='lazy' and explicit width/height attributes
index.html has preconnect links for Mapbox domains and Supabase URL
npm run build completes with 0 errors
React DevTools Profiler shows reduced re-render count for memo'd components
Browser Network tab shows earlier DNS lookups for Mapbox and Supabase due to preconnect
verification: npm run dev, open admin dashboard
Inspect element on report card images: confirm loading='lazy' width='44' height='44' present
View page source on localhost:5173: confirm preconnect links in <head>
Open React DevTools Profiler, record a session
Navigate between dashboard tabs multiple times
Stop profiler, review: ReportCard, PinMarker, dashboard sections should show '(memo)' and not render when props unchanged
Network tab: verify mapbox and supabase connections start earlier in waterfall
